data.title: bn-3rp0: Add audit-logged review retargeting for Git
data.description: Adds an append-only ReviewRetargeted event and author-only CLI command. Retargeting preserves the review base, reopens approval, clears effective votes, and records old and new anchors plus commits. Includes detached-Git, projection rebuild, error-path, and full-gate coverage.

data.reason: Superseded: automatic base included two pre-existing Edict sync commits; replacement review uses HEAD~1.
